summary.text:
Global equities rallied, driven by a rebound in US technology shares where the NDX rose 2.61% to 26726.3887 and NVDA gained 0.8% to 150.49. Market volatility retreated with the VIX dropping 11.16% to 23.81. Meanwhile, OpenAI countersued Apple over alleged trade secret theft, and S&P lowered France's credit outlook to negative as the country entered recession, though the CAC gained 0.62% to 8159.29.

In currencies, the DXY gained 0.33% to 104.014, pushing EURUSD down 0.29% to 1.0939 and USDJPY up 0.19% to 159.515. Commodities diverged sharply: gold surged 3.93% to 3674.6001, while Brent tumbled 4.77% to 90.1 and CL declined 1.03% to 82.82. Bitcoin dropped 1.18% to 59783.3984.

Looking ahead, investors are watching consumer inflation trends heading into Black Friday, fallout from the OpenAI-Apple legal dispute, and France's fiscal outlook following S&P's warning.
